meta.note: Provisional 2000-01 La Liga player classification for 7 UEFA-qualified clubs. Squad starts and primary positions reviewed against 2000-01 records; qualitative tier review uses 2000-01 > 1999-00 > 1998-99. Some exact match positions and prior two season player-by-player comparisons remain unverified. Do not regard positional ranks or Best XI as approved. Source-verified 2000-01 league starts corrected for added reserves in second pass.
meta.assessmentWeighting: 2000-01 highest > 1999-00 > 1998-99; qualitative only (no numerical weight independently calculated)
meta.qualificationNotes: Real Zaragoza qualified for 2001-02 UEFA Cup through 2000-01 Copa del Rey title despite finishing 17th in league. Villareal and Malaga did not actually enter 2001 Intertoto; the Spanish federation withdrew two places in June 2001, confirmed by contemporaneous UEFA announcement.
meta.historicalCrestPolicy: Modern/reference badges are inherited from 1999-00 season data; this stage does not establish exact 2000-01 artwork.

gkSelectionReview.notes: 14 goalkeeper candidates: Valencia reserve Andrés Palop (1 La Liga start) now included; previous snapshot had 13.
gkSelectionReview.note: Previous 13 GK candidates retained, tiers and ranks now preliminary.

tierProposal.assessmentNote: Tier adjustments and CM/AM reconciliation against user selection rules; remaining individual 3-season source audit is open. New candidates and additions had 2000-01 league starts reconciled with FBref/club records.

historicalStandingsCorrection.legacyOrigin: The legacy spreadsheet faithfully reproduces the English Wikipedia 2000–01 La Liga table (Espanyol 15W-7D-16L, 52 points); this is NOT a manual copying error.
historicalStandingsCorrection.discrepancy: English Wikipedia lists 52 points (15-7-16). Spanish Wikipedia, original LFP 2000–01 annual report, Espanyol official club retrospective, BDFutbol, FBref and RSSSF all list 50 points (14-8-16).
historicalStandingsCorrection.resolution: Retain site record of 50 points; mark contradiction as source inconsistency, not user spreadsheet error.

legacyComparison.significantDifferences: Some player primary positions and within-position ranks differ from legacy rankings; original legacy spreadsheet did not carry S-D tiers, so tiers cannot be benchmarked.
legacyComparison.reviewDisposition: Superseded by 2026-10-30 second draft: 132 candidate players and revised tier, primary position, role, rank. Original workbook is non-authoritative.
legacyComparison.verificationScope: Compared against preexisting normalized workbook extract; direct original binary not accessible in this turn.

meta.reviewDisposition: 2026-10-30 132-player working roster, rank and XI still unapproved
meta.europeanQualificationReview: Cross-checked sources and reflected in unified league-standings archive; player candidates/tiers not approved.

positionClassificationReview.rule: single primary display position per player based on 2000-01 season, subject to match-by-match checks; CM includes creative central players for 2-CM structures; CAM only exceptional standalone playmaker
positionClassificationReview.playerRoles: CB two starters + up to one backup; 2-CM structures two CM starters + one backup; other positions one starter + backup when available; no forced duplicate
caveats: Some role-specific league starts need match-by-match verification; the starts field is total league starts, not starts at assigned position.
Right wing shortage at Real Zaragoza is recorded without falsely moving forwards wide.
Club results are not direct tier inputs.
Bundled player totals are all league starts, not player position starts. Need game-by-game role audit for hybrids.
